read.en: Arm edged up 0.1% on Oct 23 to $210.33, trading between $208.50 and $215.05 on light volume, under half its 20-day average. It is below the falling 5-day ($219.2), 10-day ($231.7), 30-day ($269.9) and 100-day ($288.2) averages and the rising 200-day ($226.1). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 7 and is below zero, histogram narrowing; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Sep 28 ($248.39), and RSI is 32.
read.zh: Arm 10月23日微涨 0.1%，收于 $210.33，盘中区间 $208.50–215.05，成交清淡，不到 20 日均量的一半。股价位于下行的 5 日（$219.2）、10 日（$231.7）、30 日（$269.9）和 100 日均线（$288.2）以及上行的 200 日均线（$226.1）下方。MACD 自 10月7日起位于信号线及零轴下方，柱状图收窄；抛物线 SAR 自 9月28日起看空（$248.39），RSI 为 32。

read.en: A quiet inside day: the low held just above Wednesday's $208.3 low and the high stopped at $215. Resistance is $217.3–219.4 (Oct 20 and Aug 3 lows, 5-day), then $226 (200-day) and $232 (10-day). Support is $208.3–208.5, then $200–200.9 (May 12 low). A close above $219.4 would target $226; below $200, the next swing low is $160.9 (Oct 22, 2025).
